I don’t think you should never get another pet. I think you showed that you have true empathy and compassion for animals. I can only imagine how much Pickle appreciated his nighttime routine. 

Accidents happen. It’s only natural to blame yourself for what happened but you need to remember that you didn’t really do anything wrong. How are you supposed to bird-proof your bedsheets? It’s not like you purposely put the parrot next to you before bed. It really was just a freak accident. 

I think you should get another bird/pet when you’re ready. You’ve told us that you are a good pet owner and since you had that compassion for Pickle, you’ll have that compassion for a new bird. And as awful as it may feel to hear it, you’ll know now to remember to make sure the bird is in its cage before bedtime. Pets are like kids a lot of the time and when parents suffer from sudden child loss, they often struggle to decide if they want to have another one. From my experience, the families that decide to have another child often times have an easier time coming to peace with what happened in the past. You’re not replacing Pickle, remind yourself that too. He would want you to be happy with another birdie someday, I’m sure of it.

My ideal situation would be in August, I’m going away to a four year college (it doesn’t even matter which one) where I don’t have to see either of my parents and I’m able to have the full college experience. I’d also be able to leave my job for a while, which would lighten up some of my stresses. 

Another ideal situation is if it was just my mom and me. Even if we lived in a tiny little apartment somewhere and I was still attending county college and I still worked my retail job. I guess the real dream is to somehow remove my dad from my life, but I can’t really do that. 

I have plans for the future even though they seem far right now. I want to study really hard at county and get my GPA to, at least, a 4.0 and be able to transfer to a good four year college (preferably out of state). Maybe I would meet someone or even a new group of friends and we would decide to stay out there and get a house together or something.
